content.title: Champions League On TV Schedule UK 2025/26
content.text: Champions League On TV ScheduleLive Champions League football on TV is shown by TNT Sports and Amazon Prime Video in the UK. Amazon Prime Video have the first-pick of matches on Tuesday evenings and TNT Sports have the rights to show every other match from the 2025/26 Champions League including the 2026 UEFA Champions League final on TV.
